layout_and_spacing.general: Dense, clean bento grid for metric cards. Generous padding inside cards (p-6). Mobile-first responsive.

buttons.primary: bg-[#ec9324] text-white hover:bg-[#d4811f] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#ec9324]/50 outline-none
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gray-200 outline-none
buttons.ghost: text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

cards.metric: bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-gray-100 shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(178,178,178,0.2)] flex flex-col justify-between

tables.container: w-full text-sm text-left text-gray-600 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(178,178,178,0.2)] overflow-hidden
tables.header: text-xs text-gray-700 uppercase bg-gray-50 sticky top-0 z-10 font-bold tracking-wider border-b border-gray-200

badges.open: bg-[#ec9324]/10 text-[#ec9324] border border-[#ec9324]/20 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5
badges.closed: bg-[#b2b2b2]/10 text-gray-600 border border-[#b2b2b2]/30 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5
badges.in_progress: bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5
badges.high: bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5
badges.medium: bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5
badges.low: bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5

sidebar.container: w-64 bg-white h-screen border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col

inputs.base: w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#ec9324] focus:border-transparent

login_background.description: Minimalist facade with orange and white geometric panels to be used as a subtle, aesthetic background for the login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Manrope for both headings and body font. Provide <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'> in index.html.
The primary interactive and highlight color is #ec9324 (orange). Use it for active tabs, buttons, focus rings, and the 'Open' status badge.
Shadows should be soft, utilizing the #b2b2b2 color, e.g. shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(178,178,178,0.2)].
All cards and containers must have rounded corners (rounded-xl) and sit on a flat white background (#ffffff).
Table headers must be sticky, and rows must have hover states (hover:bg-gray-50). Ensure the table wrapper has overflow-hidden and rounded-xl.
Ensure badges for priorities (High=Red, Medium=Yellow, Low=Green) and status (Open=#ec9324, Closed=#b2b2b2, In Progress=Green) are clearly visible with readable contrast.
Implement role-based logic accurately, redirecting Admins, RAs, and DQ Team members to their respective dashboards post-login.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive and key informational elements.
